notes.title: [UPDATE] Language Update (EN/JA translation improved; TC/SC newly added)
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184315/656cf1e0e60adb9b1589b96d28be6afad9869b7f.png"]

Hello!! Time Snatchers!! 

 

We are excited to announce that language update is coming up soon, scheduled on 18th Sep.

 

\[New Languages & Quality improvements] 

Quality improvements : English, Japanese 

New languages available : Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese

 

You can change the language in Options → Language in-game. 

If you find any mistranslations or errors in the game, please comment on this post and we’ll respond quickly.

Thank you for your support!!
